data.name: PotionPanic
data.detailed_description:
Potion Panic

Potion Panic is a fast-paced cooperative potion brewing game where chaos, teamwork, and quick decision-making collide inside a magical apothecary shop.

Gather ingredients, process rare plants, brew complex potions, and fulfill customer requests before time runs out. Whether playing solo or with up to 4 players locally or online, you’ll need to balance speed, organization, and strategy while dealing with environmental hazards, aggressive plants, and increasingly demanding potion orders.

Brew Under Pressure

Each round places players inside a busy fantasy workshop where potion requests continuously appear. To complete an order, players must:

  • Harvest magical ingredients

  • Process ingredients through specialized stations

  • Combine recipes in brewing cauldrons

  • Deliver completed potions before request timers expire

As difficulty increases, recipes become more complex and require additional preparation steps such as grinding or drying ingredients to improve potion quality and score value. Incorrect recipes waste valuable.

Cooperative Chaos

Play solo or team up with up to 4 players locally or online. Coordinate responsibilities with your team to maximize efficiency. Success depends on communication, organization, and adapting to the growing chaos of the shop.

Master Magical Ingredients

Discover and work with a variety of fantasy ingredients such as Firebloom, Ghostmint, and many more. 

Different ingredient states affect recipes and scoring:

  • Raw

  • Ground

  • Dried

Choosing whether to process ingredients for higher rewards or save time by brewing immediately becomes a key strategic decision.

Upgrade Your Workshop

Earn currency during each round and invest in upgrades to improve your apothecary:

  • Faster brewing stations

  • Improved drying racks

  • Enhanced grinding stations

  • Faster plant regrowth

  • Higher scoring ingredients

Optimize your setup to match your preferred playstyle and push for higher ranks.

Survive the Hazards

As levels become more difficult, new environmental dangers appear:

  • Fires that spread throughout the shop

  • Plants that require constant watering

  • Aggressive magical plants that can attack players

  • Increased request pressure and shorter decision windows

Managing the shop becomes just as important as brewing the potions themselves.

Replayable Score-Chasing Gameplay

Potion Panic is designed for short, highly replayable sessions:

  • Rounds last approximately 2–5 minutes

  • Randomized request generation keeps runs fresh

  • Multiple rank tiers encourage replaying levels for better scores

Unlock new levels, chase Rank 3 completions, and become the Ultimate Alchemist.

Features

  • Solo or co-op gameplay for up to 4 players

  • Fast-paced time management and crafting gameplay

  • Multi-stage potion brewing system

  • Ingredient processing mechanics

  • Workshop upgrades and optimization strategies

  • Environmental hazards and dynamic challenges

  • Fantasy-inspired alchemy setting

  • Controller and keyboard/mouse support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 or Vulkan compatible, 4 GB VRAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: Quad-core
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 or Vulkan compatible, 8 GB VRAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
